metadata.desc: Monitors chat images and uses VLM to auto-classify and store them. Intelligently matches and sends stickers based on conversation mood. Supports LLM proactive sticker search, WebUI management, storage cleanup, scope repair, smart emotion matching, and multi-platform compatibility.

steal_meme.hint: Listen for and save images from chat. With manual review enabled, save originals first and classify them after approval.

steal_mode.hint: Probability mode: random chance on each received image. Cooldown mode: enforce a minimum interval between collections.

steal_chance.hint: Set to 0 to never steal, set to 1 to steal every image. Recommended 0.2~0.5. Only takes effect in probability mode.

content_filtration.hint: Uses VLM to review image content and block inappropriate images. May increase processing time per image.

qqofficial_steal_mode.hint: Large stickers and sticker packs on QQ_Official are plain image attachments without OneBot's sub_type mark. By default only images carrying the sticker CDN signature are collected (such as store stickers); collecting all images or only GIFs is also available.

auto_send_meme.hint: Automatically add a meme when the context and send probability fit. The LLM can also use meme tools proactively.

auto_meme_cancel_on_new_message.description: Cancel pending auto-send on new message
auto_meme_cancel_on_new_message.hint: Cancels the previous delayed auto-send when a new message arrives in the same session, preventing outdated replies with incorrect images.

meme_chance.hint: Set to 0 to never send, set to 1 to always send. Recommended 0.1~0.3 to avoid spamming.

send_meme_as_qq_sticker.hint: When enabled, images use QQ's custom sticker display. This applies only to aiocqhttp/NapCat.

send_meme_as_gif.hint: When enabled, always output as GIF. QQ sticker display is controlled separately. When disabled, keep the original image format.

meme_send_delay.hint: Delay before sending emoji to avoid conflicts with message-segmentation plugins. Recommended 5.0 s or more. Set to 0 to send immediately.

smart_meme_selection.hint: When enabled, uses composite scoring (diversity + relevance + similarity) to pick the best emoji. When disabled, picks randomly (still avoids short-term repeats).

enable_natural_emotion_analysis.description: Understand conversation context with a model
enable_natural_emotion_analysis.hint: When enabled, sticker usage scenes are extracted from your reply and the user message; if no model is set, the current session model is used. Adds model calls. When disabled, local matching is used.

emotion_analysis_provider_id.hint: Leave blank to use the current session model. A fast text model is enough; JEV in advanced settings can replace this step.

enable_jev.hint: Requires "Understand conversation context with a model" above. When disabled, the traditional LLM path is used; when enabled, JEV picks from up to 10 pre-filtered candidates. Uses the official endpoint and jev-latest model by default; a trusted API Base URL and JEV model ID can be set below. Sends candidate metadata, roughly the last 3 turns, and the current exchange; a none pick sends nothing, and a missing key or a failed call falls back to the LLM.

typesafe_api_key.hint: Create one at console.typesafe.ai. Used when both "Understand conversation context with a model" and "Enable JEV selection" are on; leave blank to fall back to the traditional LLM.

typesafe_api_base_url.hint: Uses the official TypeSafe API by default. Usually only the domain is needed; a value ending in /v1 or a full /v1/systemone address also works. The API key is sent to this address, so configure a trusted service only.

typesafe_model_id.hint: Leave blank to use the default jev-latest model. For a compatible proxy, enter its required model ID; for example, Command Code uses typesafe/jev.

vision_provider_id.hint: Used for image classification. Leave blank to auto-use AstrBot's global default_image_caption_provider_id.

send_target_whitelist.hint: Format: group:group_id or user:user_id. When non-empty, only whitelisted targets can receive stickers.

send_target_blacklist.hint: Format: group:group_id or user:user_id. Can be combined with whitelist; the priority rule below controls conflict resolution.

send_target_filter_mode.hint: Whitelist first: allow if whitelist hit, otherwise check blacklist. Blacklist first: deny if blacklist hit, otherwise check whitelist.

steal_target_whitelist.hint: Format: group:group_id or user:user_id. When non-empty, only whitelisted targets allow collection.

steal_target_blacklist.hint: Format: group:group_id or user:user_id. Can be combined with whitelist; the priority rule below controls conflict resolution.

steal_target_filter_mode.hint: Whitelist first: allow if whitelist hit, otherwise check blacklist. Blacklist first: deny if blacklist hit, otherwise check whitelist.

max_reg_num.hint: Storage limit. When the limit is reached, old emoji are automatically removed per the cleanup strategy.

eviction_usage_weight.hint: Default 0.7; the entry-time weight is 1 minus this value. Both scores are normalised and weighted: rarely used and oldest entries are evicted first. 0 evicts by age only, 1 by least usage only.

steal_pool_capacity.hint: Auto-stolen images go to the pending pool first. When this limit is reached, stealing pauses until items are reviewed (approved or deleted) in the WebUI. Changes take effect immediately, no restart needed.

audit_required.hint: Automatically collected originals wait for manual review before vision analysis. Approval queues background analysis immediately; successful results enter the library. Failed originals are kept for retry. With manual review off, automatic analysis continues; explicit capture commands analyze immediately.

enable_embedding_search.hint: When enabled, remote text embeddings recall stickers by overlay text + usage scenes + description. When disabled, keyword (BM25) search is used. No local CLIP. Falls back to BM25 if no embedding model is configured.

embedding_provider_id.hint: Leave blank to use the first framework embedding provider. The plugin detects actual output dimensions and rebuilds vectors in the background when the model or dimensions change; local matching remains available. If the service rejects the dimensions request parameter, disable that parameter or use a supported value in the AstrBot provider settings.

external_sources_enabled.hint: Supports Meme Manager / AstrBot Meme Pack, GitHub repositories, and constrained JSON APIs. Imports are copied into this plugin.

external_source_allow_http.hint: HTTPS is required by default. Loopback, private, link-local, and reserved addresses remain blocked.

external_source_default_review.description: Send external imports to Pending by default
external_source_default_review.hint: External imports also enter Pending automatically when content moderation is enabled.

webui_theme.hint: Theme used when opening the sticker manager. Picking a theme in the page is remembered and takes priority over this setting.

custom_meme_classification_prompt.hint: Supports placeholder: {emotion_list} (category list). Leave blank to use the default prompt.

custom_meme_classification_with_filter_p.hint: Used when content moderation is enabled. Supports placeholder: {emotion_list} (category list). Leave blank to use the default prompt.

emotion_analysis_prompt.hint: Leave blank to use the bundled context prompt. The query keeps the assistant's stance, interaction intent and key lines; custom content still takes effect. Placeholders: {emotion_list}, {llm_reply}, {user_message}.

sim_weight_preset.hint: Preset controls how multiple similarity algorithms are fused: Balanced (default), Keyword-first (substring/character overlap), Semantic-first (n-gram/cosine), Strict (edit distance & character-level, reduces false sends).

show_advanced_settings.hint: Reveal tuning, per-session filters and external-source options. Existing values remain active when hidden.

meme_send_char_delay.hint: Default 0 uses the fixed send delay. Enable only to add a reading delay.

model_request_interval.hint: This plugin sends vision and embedding requests serially per provider, with at least 5 seconds between starts by default. Increase for low free-tier quotas or reduce for paid providers. Rate limits respect Retry-After; failed jobs remain available for retry.

categories.key_hint: Keys start with a letter and use lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens (48 characters maximum). Display names may use any language.

reanalysis.title: Batch re-analysis
reanalysis.confirm:
Analyze {count} selected images?
Results will wait for individual review. Nothing is saved automatically.
reanalysis.hint: Review and confirm each result before saving. Categories, characters, favorites, provenance and scope are kept.
reanalysis.background_hint: Analysis continues after closing this panel or page. Reload to resume review. Restarting the plugin ends the task and clears unsaved results.
reanalysis.interrupted: The plugin restarted and unsaved analysis results were cleared. Your library was not changed.

batch.drag_upload: Click or drag to upload multiple images
batch.supported_formats: Supports PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, BMP
batch.default_category_hint: Images will be saved into this category unless auto analyze is enabled.
batch.auto_analyze: Auto analyze each image and classify automatically
batch.auto_analyze_disabled_hint: Clear the selected category before enabling auto analyze.
batch.auto_analyze_warning: Images are analyzed one at a time using the configured model request interval. You can close this panel while processing continues.
batch.scope_hint: Images missing origin group info will be skipped when setting local scope.
batch.character_hint: This batch will be tagged with the selected character. You can change it later.

alerts.scope_origin_missing: This image is missing origin group info and cannot be set to local.
alerts.select_category_or_auto: Select a category or enable auto analyze.
alerts.invalid_category_key: Category keys must start with a letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens (48 characters maximum).
alerts.reserved_category_key: This category key is reserved by the operating system. Choose another key.
alerts.duplicate_category_name: This category display name is already in use.

Delete and blacklist this image?
It will no longer be auto-collected.
confirm.delete_image: Delete this image? This action cannot be undone.
confirm.storage_cleanup: Found {count} cleanable item(s). This will remove stale indexes, orphan files, thumbnail cache, and temp files. Continue?
confirm.delete_category: Delete category {key}? Images in this category will be deleted permanently.
confirm.delete_character: Delete character {key}? Stickers stay; only the character tag is removed.

prompt.origin_scope: Enter the origin scope, for example group:123456 or user:123456.

themes.title: Theme
themes.save_hint: Your pick is saved as the default theme.

characters.title: Characters
characters.hint: You assign characters in the dashboard. VLM does not detect them. Create a character first, then edit a card or batch-assign.
characters.bar_hint: Filter the library by character. Use Manage characters to add or remove them.

sources.title: External Sources
sources.copy_hint: Imports are validated, deduplicated, and copied into this plugin. Other plugins' original files remain unchanged.
sources.format_hint: Preferred AstrBot Meme Pack v2: manifest.json + memes/, optionally semantic_metadata.json. ZIPs containing PNG/JPG/GIF/WEBP/BMP images are also accepted; previews/ is skipped.
sources.capacity_note: This pack exceeds the native collection limit. External copies use a protected retention class.
sources.assign_character: Assign a character to this series
sources.character_hint: Existing keys are reused; a new key is created during import.
sources.empty: No registered sources. Same-instance Meme Manager packs appear automatically.
sources.forget_confirm: Forget this source? Imported images will remain in your library.

libraries.hint: Only ordinary general stickers are automatically evicted. Favorites, character stickers and protected imports are managed separately. Removing favorite or character protection returns ordinary stickers to the quota.

guide.title: Get started · Match the conversation
guide.collect_hint: Upload and analyze images, or enable collection and choose a vision model in plugin settings.
guide.review_hint: Approve collected images, check the overlay text and incoming messages they suit, then assign characters.
guide.chat_hint: The bot can express emotion, share a joke or react with a meme during ordinary conversation. It chooses images that fit the conversation.
guide.pending_hint: Pending images are not sent. If an approved image matches poorly, preview a new analysis and confirm before saving.
